title: oma.json
description: Opt-in oma project configuration. Data only: the CLI reads it today and omarchy itself can consume it natively later.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema so editors autocomplete and validate.

icon.description: Global icon for the plugin: a freedesktop icon name or a file path. Used by launcher entries and available to surfaces.

panel.description: Panel presentation mode. 'attached' (default) is the bar-anchored popup, 'window' is a standalone draggable FloatingWindow, 'both' generates both.

launchers.description: Launcher entries written to ~/.local/share/applications/<id>.desktop on 'oma install' / 'oma launcher add'. Absent or empty means nothing is ever created.

action.description: Shell action applied to the plugin id. Default: summon.

exec.description: Full Exec= override. When set, action is ignored.

icon.description: Overrides the global icon for this entry.

genericName.description: Desktop Entry GenericName. Default: kind label (Panel, Overlay, ...).

comment.description: Desktop Entry Comment. Default: manifest description.

keywords.description: Desktop Entry Keywords. Default: name words + id segments.
